entities.summary: René-Levasseur Island is a large island in the centre of Lake Manicouagan in Quebec, Canada. Its highest peak is Mount Babel, at 952 m, which is contained in the Louis-Babel Ecological Reserve. The Manicouagan Reservoir and René-Levasseur Island are sometimes called the "eye of Quebec".
